e.title: ratingtables
e.summary: 表驱动保险评级引擎（CRAN 0.2.0）：费率计划执行/覆盖特定评级/实体聚合/审计追踪
e.summary_en: Table-driven insurance rating engine (CRAN 0.2.0): rating plan execution/coverage-specific specs/entity aggregation/audit traces
e.summary_hk: 表驅動保險評級引擎（CRAN 0.2.0）：費率計劃執行/覆蓋特定評級/實體聚合/審計追蹤
e.body: ratingtables（CRAN 0.2.0）提供轻量级表驱动保险评级引擎：执行保险评级计划——覆盖特定评级规格、实体聚合、审计追踪输出——给定保单数据、有序评级规格与费率因子表，返回评级保单及可选的逐步计算追踪。对 RIAA：费率手册的执行引擎——[[insurancerating]]（GLM 定价）的费率表落地层；审计追踪（step-by-step trace）支持 [[insurance-governance]]（模型治理/监管审计）；表驱动（factor tables）是费率手册的数字形态（[[pc-pricing-tutorial]] 实务）；与 [[illogical]]（规则引擎）、[[insurance-deploy]]（部署）配套；适合定价实务与费率管理。
e.body_en: ratingtables (CRAN 0.2.0) provides a lightweight, table-driven engine for executing insurance rating plans: coverage-specific rating specifications, entity aggregation, audit-trace output — given policy data, an ordered rating specification and rating factor tables, it returns rated policies with an optional step-by-step trace. For RIAA: the execution engine of rating manuals — the factor-table landing layer of [[insurancerating]] (GLM pricing); audit traces support [[insurance-governance]] (model governance/regulatory audits); table-driven factor tables are the digital form of rating manuals (the practice of [[pc-pricing-tutorial]]); pairs with [[illogical]] (rule engine) and [[insurance-deploy]] (deployment); suits pricing practice and rate management.
e.body_hk: ratingtables（CRAN 0.2.0）提供輕量級表驅動保險評級引擎：執行保險評級計劃——覆蓋特定評級規格、實體聚合、審計追蹤輸出——給定保單數據、有序評級規格與費率因子表，返回評級保單及可選的逐步計算追蹤。對 RIAA：費率手冊的執行引擎——[[insurancerating]]（GLM 定價）的費率表落地層；審計追蹤（step-by-step trace）支持 [[insurance-governance]]（模型治理/監管審計）；表驅動（factor tables）是費率手冊的數字形態（[[pc-pricing-tutorial]] 實務）；與 [[illogical]]（規則引擎）、[[insurance-deploy]]（部署）配套；適合定價實務與費率管理。
e.verified_note: CRAN 官方页面核实（v0.2.0，表驱动评级引擎），未实测
